name: git-gates
description: Gates git work: no commit, push or merge without the user's say-so in the current turn; a push to a branch that already landed is refused; a pushed series must leave the project working at every commit; commit messages (format and the issue it is about, then a Haiku review of the body) and MR descriptions kept tidy; merged, clean work gets a follow-up to remove its worktree and branches.
